creation_total_note: Every character begins with exactly 100 + 12 = 112 attribute points. Race is the only source of net gain (sum of race deltas = +12); class only redistributes (sum of class deltas = 0). RI-CHR01 §2.

attributes.name: STRENGTH
attributes.in_fight: STR-scaling damage; shield stability; heavy-weapon requirement
attributes.out_of_fight: Max equip load; carry capacity for loot; forcing doors and chests
attributes.past_hard_cap: scaling +0.005/pt; equip load keeps rising linearly (the one uncapped return)

attributes.name: ENDURANCE
attributes.in_fight: Max stamina; stamina regen rate; poise floor
attributes.out_of_fight: Max Fatigue (S4 second bar); recovery from Fatigue-0

attributes.name: AGILITY
attributes.in_fight: AGI-scaling damage; bow draw speed; roll distance
attributes.out_of_fight: Lockpick tier ceiling; pickpocket; trap disarm
attributes.past_hard_cap: scaling +0.005/pt; lockpick tier 5 reached at 60, nothing above

attributes.name: SPEED
attributes.in_fight: NOTHING, explicitly. AR-1 guard: while COMBAT is active, SPEED's contribution to locomotion is clamped to zero.
attributes.out_of_fight: Out-of-combat move and sprint speed; swim speed; sprint stamina drain; travel-time modifier on the world map
attributes.past_hard_cap: move speed capped at 1.28x base; travel-time modifier caps at -18%

attributes.name: VIGOUR
attributes.in_fight: Max HP; bleed and frost resistance

attributes.name: WILLPOWER
attributes.in_fight: Max Focus (FP); spell-slot count; status-resist (curse, fear, madness)
attributes.out_of_fight: Resistance to intimidation and illusion in dialogue; Fatigue drain rate

attributes.name: INTELLECT
attributes.out_of_fight: Alchemy potency; number of ingredient effects read; gating on scholarly dialogue topics and unreliable-book comprehension
attributes.past_hard_cap: scaling +0.005/pt; 4th ingredient effect at 80 is the last unlock

attributes.name: HIST-BOND
attributes.in_fight: Root/restoration and Hist-invocation scaling; miracle-equivalent access
attributes.out_of_fight: HEARTH attunement quality; Hist-related faction rank thresholds

attributes.name: PERSONALITY
attributes.out_of_fight: Base disposition of every NPC; buy/sell price multiplier; persuasion success band; faction rank requirements; whether a bribe is even offered
attributes.past_hard_cap: price multiplier hits its 0.80/0.60 clamps at ~70

attributes.name: LUCK
attributes.in_fight: Status buildup you inflict (bleed/poison/rot); resistance to instant-death effects
attributes.out_of_fight: Rare hand-placed cache reveal prompts; gambling and wager outcomes; critical-failure avoidance on lockpicks and alchemy
attributes.past_hard_cap: buildup rate flattens; cache-reveal chance caps
